notes: Fixed the Drive Mapping page overflowing the Settings drawer and forcing horizontal scrolling.
Bundled Rip Node API v0.2.7 adds an explicit hot-plug hardware refresh so newly connected optical drives appear in assignment selectors.
Fixed successful Node updates being shown as failed when a legacy updater acknowledgement produced HTTP 422.
Added a confirmed Restart Rip Manager button under Settings > System; active Node rips continue independently.
The Simulator update tile is hidden whenever simulation is disabled.
GitHub update checks remain automatic but all Manager and Node installations remain manual-only.
